approval_source: Explicit user SIGA in current conversation, scoped only to SWHNK-L03-BINAH-SEMANTIC-CURRICULAR-SOURCE-MAPPING-HUMAN-BATCH-V1.

mapping_decisions.statement: Approve CONTEXT_PLACE as a source lane containing VALIVAN (LEX-003) and PARAZAMO (LEX-004), with no locative syntax or sentence-frame inference.
Approve ACTIVITY as a source lane containing PARAZAMI (LEX-012) and VALI (LEX-013), preserving WATCH/FROZEN authority and inferring no predicate grammar.
Approve INTENTION_NEED_PURPOSE as a source lane containing DAYI (LEX-016), SALI (LEX-017) and TA (LEX-019), preserving CANDIDATE/WATCH boundaries and inferring no modal grammar.
Approve HABITUALITY_EVIDENCE_ONLY as a source lane containing SARU (LEX-018) only, with recovered gloss 'todos os dias / habitualidade' and no equivalence to 'usually'.
Keep the curriculum target 'I usually...' unresolved in HNK; SARU is supporting evidence only and cannot fill the structure by itself.
Keep all eight approved bindings eligible only as source evidence for later curriculum allocation; assign zero of the 139 slots under this gate.

governance_decisions.statement: Semantic mapping is not authoring, validation, authority promotion, registry rebind application or runtime activation.
No word order, locative, predicate, modal, habitual, frequency, aspect, tense or morphology grammar may be inferred from these lanes.
FROZEN/WATCH/CANDIDATE labels remain unchanged; no WATCH or CANDIDATE item is promoted by curriculum relevance.
Reference languages may compare semantics only and numerology may govern counts only; neither selects HNK forms or grammar.
L01/L02 scoped grammar is not inherited into L03 as universal or Binah grammar.
If approved, prepare a separate L03 curriculum-lane allocation/source-architecture gate; do not author OPI, SQS, vocabulary, activation or review items with the same approval.
